packageRules.description: gtk and cairo-rs must stay on webkit2gtk 2.0 and Tauri's GTK3 stack (gtk-rs 0.18). A newer gtk conflicts on gdk-sys's native links; snapshot.rs also needs the same cairo surface type. Raise these together when Tauri and WebKitGTK support the new stack.
mxc-sdk follows crmne/microsoft-mxc's local-services branch, pinned by hand: Renovate's digest updates follow the fork's default branch and would take Desktop back before the commits it needs.
